items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source.

items.title: Adobe Commerce RCE Vulnerability (Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type)
items.summary: An Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type vulnerability (CWE-434) in Adobe Commerce, B2B, Magento Open Source, and Adobe I/O Events connector allows attackers to execute arbitrary code by uploading malicious files.

items.title: Unauthenticated arbitrary file upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: A critical flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to a Magento store without logging in, leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP object injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: An unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a Magento extension, allows remote code execution via a crafted cookie on any storefront page.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: These vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce relate to incorrect authorization, potentially allowing attackers to bypass security measures.

items.title: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: An SSRF vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could allow an attacker to make requests from the server to other internal or external systems.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Multiple stored XSS vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce could allow attackers to inject malicious scripts into web pages, potentially leading to session hijacking or defacement.

items.title: Path Traversal in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: These path traversal vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce could allow an attacker to access arbitrary files and directories on the server.

items.title: Improper Authorization in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: An improper authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could allow an attacker to perform actions they are not authorized to do.

items.title: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: These vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce involve uncontrolled resource consumption, which could lead to denial of service or other impacts.

items.title: Improper Input Validation in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: An improper input validation vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could lead to various impacts depending on the context of exploitation.

items.title: Unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce REST API
items.summary: Sansec discovered PolyShell, a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files using a polyglot technique, leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Critical Security Update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This bulletin addresses multiple critical vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to bypass security mechanisms, gain escalated privileges, and execute unauthorized malicious code in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source.
